THE TOOL, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'OLMoTrace is the first real-time system that traces language model outputs back to multi-trillion-token training datasets. Developed by the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) and winner of Best Demo at ACL 2025, it lets users inspect the exact training text that influenced a model's response.'
